purpose: Define the production hook/premise/inciting-situation record shape used by GCL-02 compact library shards and their deterministic expansion into the GCL-01 reusable-template grammar.
controlling_rule: A hook gives a reason to engage, a disruption/opportunity/obligation or unanswered pressure, and useful replaceable parts. It must not prescribe one solution, one player choice, one canonical outcome or runtime truth.

nonauthorization: does not create an Adventure, Campaign, Scene, Encounter or Session
does not require a player choice
does not reveal unauthorized Campaign information
does not grant entitlement or permission
does not publish or promote itself automatically

stable_id_rule: hook_id must begin gcl:hook. and remain stable across wording-only revisions; semantic breaking changes require a new template version or new hook_id.
parameterization_rule: Premise and trigger patterns may use declared {slot_id} placeholders only. Every placeholder must appear in slot_ids and every slot_id must be declared by the materialization profile or shard slot extension.

slot_vocabulary.semantic_role: person, group, institution or other governed initiator
person, place, object, resource, secret or state at issue
place or region connected to the hook
change, anomaly, interruption or destabilizing event
promise, duty, debt, contract, expectation or responsibility
possible gain, access, discovery, advantage or transformation
clue, message, sign, testimony or observable indicator
time window, countdown or closing opportunity
law, hierarchy, institution or recognized decision maker
prior choice, event, failure, victory or unresolved history
new person, group, object, force or phenomenon entering context

solution_openness.rule: A record may suggest stakes, escalation and questions but may not state that the players must solve the hook in a particular way.

discovery_rule: Normal recommendation should filter by construction need, play emphasis, scope, duration, prep depth, tone and intent tags before exposing expert driver-family browsing.
composition_rule: Hooks may compose into GCL-03 situations, GCL-05 objectives, GCL-06 complications, GCL-09 mysteries, GCL-10 adventures, GCL-13 NPC roles and owning CSW/F005 structures, but composition remains proposal-only until the consumer accepts it.
